FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Stats Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds a couple new stats to influence resource production.

patchNoteLines.li: Add workerProductionBase and workerProductionMultiplier to easily modify production for all of a settlement's resources

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Minor UI and debug action fixes

patchNoteLines.li: Updates the "Add Stat Modifier" debug action to add the stat's label to the new modifier description
Updates the resource display on the main tab window to actually use the full space

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Building slot fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Actually respect the max building slot count specified by a WorldSettlementDef

patchNoteLines.li: When calculating a settlement's max building slots, enforce the settlement type's def as a hard cap

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor building slot fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Extensibility fixes for settlement building slots.

patchNoteLines.li: Changes the tooltip for locked building slots to show the actual requirements, if overriden

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Settlement type fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fix for handling of settlement types. Mostly relevant for submods.

patchNoteLines.li: When getting a WorldSettlementDef's SettlementTypeExtension, always grab the last one in the modExtensions list. This should account for xml inheritance
